title: Modular Greenfield Graphene Manufacturing Facility: Systems Architecture, Simulation Framework & Custom Configuration Suite
description: Systems-level production planning, utility-closure, 90-day overlapping constraint buffering, expansion/vertical-integration governance, and ISO/IEC pilot calibration framework for a modular greenfield graphene manufacturing facility (macro skids only; excludes piece-part BOMs). Co-developed by Abhishek Singh with Google Gemini assistance.
